# scoop-boot apt package list TEMPLATE for DevOps and infrastructure (delivered by
# scoop-boot.ps1 --update; do not edit). scoop-boot.ps1 --package-template=devops
# copies it to etc\packages\<hostname>.debian.txt, which --wsl-setup then uses
# instead of debian.txt. Network, automation and server tools instead of compilers.
# Azure CLI and kubectl come from the Windows side (Scoop): Debian's azure-cli is
# old and Ubuntu has no kubectl package.

ca-certificates

# Version control and remote access

ansible

# Data formats
jq
